name: comp-64
blurb: Textarea with error state and red error message.
description: A textarea with aria-invalid attribute showing an error state. Error message displayed below in destructive color, marked as role='alert'.
use_when: Displaying validation errors (too short, invalid input, etc.) in forms.
avoid_when: The error is only temporary (use a toast notification instead).
a11y: Label linked to textarea. Textarea marked aria-invalid. Error message is role='alert' with aria-live='polite'.
